name: Britannia Toastea Milk Rusk
ingredients_raw: WHEAT FLOUR (72%), SUGAR, INTERESTERIFIED VEGETABLE FAT (PALM & SESAME), SWEET CONDENSED MILK & SKIM MILK POWDER (6.9), YEAST, BUTTER (1.4%), DRY GLUTEN (WHEAT), SALT, ENZYMES (FUNGAL ALPHA AMYLASE, LIPASE) AND EMULSIFIER (SODIUM STEAROYL 2-LACTYLATE). CONTAINS: WHEAT (GLUTEN), MILK PRODUCTS AND SESAME MAY CONTAINS NUTS AND SULPHITE INGRÉDIENTS: FARINE DE BLÉ (72%), SUCRE, GRAISSE VEGETALE INTERESTERIFIEE (PALME ET SÉSAME), LAIT CONCENTRE SUCRE ET LAIT ÉCRÉMÉ EN POUDRE (6.9%), LEVURE, BEURRE (1.4%), GLUTEN SEC (BLÉ), SEL, ENZYME (ALPHA-AMYLASE FONGIQUE, LIPASE), EMULSIFIANT (SODIUM STEAROYL 2 LACTYLATE). CONTIENT: BLÉ (GLUTEN), PRODUITS LAITIERS ET SESAME PEUT CONTENIR NOIX ET SULFITES
